name: Fogo de Chão Dubai
questions: Is the Dubai pão de queijo made with only cassava/tapioca flour, with no wheat?
Are any meats marinated or basted with wheat-containing sauces (e.g. soy or beer)?
Can I see your allergen list?
Is the polenta fried in a shared fryer?
quinoa_oat_flags: Market table/salad bar not checked; ask about quinoa grain salads

safe_dishes.note: Described as GF (yucca/cassava flour) at other Fogo locations; not confirmed for Dubai

summary: The pão de queijo is called gluten-free at Fogo's US locations, but I found no Dubai-specific allergen information, so ask first (the Dubai sources are undated reviews).
